sources.finding: Fetched feature updates become pending next state; background startup loads persisted flags while existing UI views use loaded state.
Persist fetched feature flags before dispatching their pending-state update.
On a feature update, wait for zero open extension views, flush persisted state and request application reload.
The signed implementation performs its own runtime.reload.
Visible node and indexer radio accessibility labels contain the same effective URLs as the adjacent text; Save submits those network values with the selected prover mode.

conclusions: A successful feature-service response alone does not establish activation in the running wallet.
Closing all ordinary extension views allows the signed wallet to activate pending configuration through its own background reload.
A replacement worker alone is not configuration attestation; current visible service labels before Save and actual connector URLs afterward remain required.
A plain UI-page reload can continue using the existing background loaded feature set.
